items.name: Tårnby Cube Træf 2019
items.information:
Dette er den 3. version af Tårnby Cube Træf. Udover officielle WCA dicsipliner kommer der også til at blive afholdt fire uofficielle discipliner: Kilominx, TeamBLD, re-scramble, og dodgeball cubing i løbet af weekenden. Det står i tidsskemaet, hvornår de vil foregå!

Hvis du tilmelder dig Kilominx på eller før d. 20. oktober vil du modtage en gratis Kilominx fra konkurrencens sponsor, Kube Ninja!

----

This is the 3rd edition of Tårnby Cube Træf. In addition to WCA-reocgnized events, there will also be 4 unofficial events: Kilominx, TeamBLD, re-scramble, and dodgeball cubing at different times in the weekend, see the schedule for when these will be held!

If you register for Kilominx on or before October 20th, you will receive a free Kilominx from the competition sponsor, Kube Ninja!

items.name: Nacionales Guatemala 2019
items.information:
Esta competencia, al ser de carácter nacional, busca incluir la mayor participación posible, con el objetivo de generar puestos y podios confiables.

This national competition, tries to include the highest possible participation, with the purpose of generating accurate rankings and podiums.
